definitions.explanation: Activities, study, or events that take place outside of regular class hours or the standard curriculum.

examples.japanese: {課外|かがい}{活動|かつどう}に{参加|さんか}する。
{放課後|ほうかご}に{課外|かがい}{授業|じゅぎょう}がある。
examples.english: There is an extracurricular class after school.

examples.japanese: {課外|かがい}の{学習|がくしゅう}を{通|とお}して、{生徒|せいと}たちは{社会|しゃかい}{経験|けいけん}を{積|つ}んでいる。
examples.english: Through extracurricular learning, the students are gaining social experience.

notes:
Almost always used as a modifier before another noun, functioning like a prefix meaning "outside the regular curriculum." Composed of {課|か} (lesson/curriculum) + {外|がい} (outside). Rarely used as a standalone noun.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {課外|かがい}{活動|かつどう}: extracurricular activities
- {課外|かがい}{授業|じゅぎょう}: extracurricular lessons; supplementary classes
- {課外|かがい}{学習|がくしゅう}: extracurricular learning/study
- {課外|かがい}{講座|こうざ}: extracurricular course
- {課外|かがい}{研究|けんきゅう}: extracurricular research

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {部活|ぶかつ}: club activities — the most common term for after-school club activities at Japanese schools
- {放課後|ほうかご}: after school — refers to the time period after classes end, not the activities themselves
- {校外|こうがい}: off-campus; outside school — refers to physical location outside the school grounds, while {課外|かがい} refers to being outside the curriculum
